name: mxlens-monorepo
description: MXLens: explainable, privacy-first email phishing analysis — engine, CLI, MCP server and web app.
author: Akmal Muhammed

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mxlens/engine && npm run build -w mxlens && npm run build -w @mxlens/mcp
